## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — adds the per-agent schema-preservation sub-section that the task-decomposer agent stub references. DD ownership is implicit via the UPDATE agent task that depends on this sub-section existing.)

## Description

Add a named sub-section to plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md titled exactly `### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer`.

PATH NOTE: same path-resolution caveat as the approach-proposer sub-section task. Resolve actual location at runtime via `ls` of both candidate paths. Edit whichever exists.

The sub-section MUST specify, for delta-mode task-decomposer output:
1. Which top-level keys are preserved verbatim when not named in any finding (task_drafts, dd_partition_map, decomposition_notes).
2. Preserve-by-omission rule: tasks not named in any finding MUST appear unchanged in delta output (including their full AC list, file_impact, depends_on, retry_budget).
3. TDD-schema preservation: for tasks being modified, the RED-before-GREEN sequencing (task ordering), the depends_on chain (no orphaned edges), and the testing_mode field (RED/GREEN/UPDATE) MUST be preserved.
4. DD-partition-map invariant: every DD continues to be owned by exactly one task; delta-mode output may not silently drop or duplicate DD ownership.
5. Universal-AC preservation: each preserved or modified task still carries the three universal AC lines (unit tests, lint, format-check) as its first three AC entries.

Do NOT edit any other section of the protocol doc, and do NOT touch the approach-proposer sub-section.

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria

- Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- Protocol doc exists at one of the two candidate paths — Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md || test -f plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md
- Sub-section header exists — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && grep -qF '### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer' "$PROTO"
- Sub-section enumerates the three preserved top-level keys — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'task_drafts' && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'dd_partition_map'
- Sub-section states the TDD-preservation invariants — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'RED-before-GREEN' && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'depends_on' && awk '/^### Schema Preservation — task-decomposer/,/^### /' "$PROTO" | grep -qE 'testing.mode'
- Approach-proposer sub-section (added by prior task) is not modified — Verify: PROTO=$(ls plugins/dso/docs/remediation-loop-protocol.md plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md 2>/dev/null | head -1) && grep -qF '### Schema Preservation — approach-proposer' "$PROTO"
data.title: UPDATE: add task-decomposer schema-preservation sub-section to remediation-loop-protocol.md (TDD invariant: RED-before-GREEN, depends_on, testing_mode)
